country_code: UTC+2/UTC+3): station feeds are snapshotted daily at 09:35-10:00 Bucharest time; Italy = day of the MIMIT daily file (prices in force at about 08:00 that day
region_type: published by MIMIT the next morning; since version 2026-09.7); Romania = last price read that day; Greece = day of the source bulletin.
